summary: A climber fell a short distance while descending Mother's Buttress in Unaweep Canyon and reported a badly injured leg; Mesa County SAR Ground Team lowered the patient down the hill via low-angle rope; transported to hospital by CareFlight.
location: Mother's Buttress, Unaweep Canyon, Mesa County
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County SAR, Gateway Fire Dept, CareFlight
